description: This bar chart, titled “The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful Communication Datasets,” illustrates the number of datasets collected annually from 2012 to 2022, categorized by geographic origin. The horizontal axis represents the year, ranging from 2012 to 2022, while the vertical axis, labeled “Number of datasets,” uses a logarithmic scale spanning from 10⁰ to 10². A legend in the upper left corner identifies six categories: “Other” (blue), “UK” (red), “USA” (orange), “IT” (purple), “IN” (green), and “DE” (brown). Each year displays a single bar for each category, with the bar height corresponding to the count of datasets for that origin in that year. For example, in 2012, the “USA” category (orange bar) shows approximately 1 dataset, while “Other” (blue) shows approximately 1 dataset. In 2016, “USA” (orange) reaches approximately 10 datasets, “Other” (blue) reaches approximately 5 datasets, and “UK” (red) reaches approximately 2 datasets. The “USA” category consistently shows the highest number of datasets throughout the period, peaking at approximately 100 in 2021. The “Other” category also shows a significant increase, reaching approximately 100 in 2021 and remaining high in 2022. The bars are not sorted and are presented in chronological order along the x-axis, with no visual emphasis or annotation applied to any specific bar.
